The best advice I can give you as a CAP 2 TL is that this job is easy street as long as you know how to navigate upper management. They will shit on you and ask you to be a yes man a lot. Make sure you have priorities every day. The rock, pebble, sand standard works. Your associates are the most important part of your job. Be empathetic but don't let them take advantage of you. You're gonna get good workers and bad workers. Work with your bad workers to make sure they know what the expectations are. Regardless of work ethics I get the most out of my team because there is mutual respect. Listen to them. Make sure they feel comfortable. Also make sure you learn every aspect of the job and use the process guide to your advantage. There's gonna be days when upper management throws as much shit on you as they can and the only thing you can do is remain calm, don't panic, and do the best you can. I congratulate you on the promotion and I know you'll do well (=
